name: Dinari
description: Dinari dShares revolutionizes access to global stock markets by leveraging blockchain technology, enabling seamless, transparent trading of real-world assets worldwide. Our platform bridges traditional finance and DeFi, democratizing investment in major stocks for a global audience.

methodology.Fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares).
methodology.UserFees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees are paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees are revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees go to the protocol.
methodology.Volume: Payment-token notional of dShare orders (buys counted at request, sells at settlement).

Fees.Trading Fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares).

UserFees.Trading Fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees are paid by users.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees are revenue.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Trading fees (flat + variable) charged on buy and sell orders of tokenized stocks (dShares). All fees go to the protocol.
